rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a large indefinite number of people or things, including when it stands alone as “many.”

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 hou2 do1 haak3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a large number, including emphatic “so many.”

example.english: I have many books at home.
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jau5 hou2 do1 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use this for demonstrative or degree meanings such as “this many” and “so many.”

example.english: Why did you buy so many apples?
example.jyutping: nei5 maai5 gam3 do1 ping4 gwo2 zou6 mat1 aa3

rows.note: Use this for the comparative meaning “as many” or “the same number.”

example.english: The two teams have as many people as each other.
example.traditional: 我哋兩隊有一樣咁多人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 deoi6 jau5 jat1 joeng6 gam3 do1 jan4
